appDesc.message: A Floating Mini Player for Youtube that can be Operated From Anywhere.

autoLinkDescription.message: Automatically link to newly detected videos

findVideoDescription.message: Navigate to any page with a video. When a video is detected, the Wipeyy icon will appear.

iconAppears.message: The Wipeyy icon appears when a video is detected

saveVideoDescription.message: Click the Wipeyy icon or press Alt+S to save the current video to your collection.

accessVideosDescription.message: Click the Wipeyy extension icon in your browser toolbar or press Alt+W to view your saved videos.

linkVideosDescription.message: Click 'link to movie' on any video to make it your active video for picture-in-picture view.

multipleWindowsDescription.message: Wipeyy works across all your browser windows and tabs.

saveVideoPrompt.message: Videos will be automatically detected while browsing

detectVideosDescription.message: Videos are automatically detected when you visit pages containing video elements. No action is required.

accessPopupDescription.message: Click the Wipeyy extension icon in your browser toolbar to view a list of all currently detected videos.

controlVideoDescription.message: Use keyboard shortcuts to control the linked video, including play/pause, skip forward/backward, and toggle picture-in-picture mode.

globalShortcutDescription.message: Select "Global" from the dropdown menu to control videos even when the browser is not in focus.

featurePiP.message: Picture-in-picture mode for any detected video

featureControls.message: Keyboard controls for playback (play/pause, skip forward/backward)

featureGlobal.message: Global shortcuts that work even when browser is not in focus (need select Global from keyboard shortcut settings)

featureMultipleWindows.message: Works across all browser windows and tabs
